title: Gift of Melancholic Memories

fields.label: Function
fields.value: It is believed to play the original music from "Woodmill INC"

body:
Trade-only
This item is no longer available unless by means of trading with another player.

"A musical past, or so to speak..."

Description

This is an exclusive gift only given to those who purchased and played Typical Developers Previous game "Woodmill INC" Before it was taken down, and is no longer obtainable to those who did not play it.

Trivia

  • Woodmill Inc. Pre-Alpha lasted from 7/20/21 until 8/16/21, where only 1000 people bought access.
  • Due to how few people bought access and how long it has been, this item and the Edward Statue are the current rarest items in the game, with an estimation of ~50 people who are still around since then.
  • Some people recognize the music played as the Menu/Daytime music from a game called Treelands developed by New Fissy another game that took inspiration from Lumber Tycoon.
  • The item is unusual as initially the item spawns as a small crate-like object. Opening it then reveals the Gift of Melancholic Memories.
